facility.name: La Petite Academy Beech Trail
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6865 BEECH TRAIL DR, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78244

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The fire inspection from May 2024 was posted on the wall.  The 2025 inspection was never posted, and it was due 6/5/2026.  The director did not follow up with the Fire Marshall until July 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Two files out of 10 employee files did not have a notarized affidavit, Form 2985.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection from May 2024 was posted on the wall.  The 2025 inspection was never posted, and it was due 6/5/2026.  The director did not follow up with the Fire Marshall until July 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Two personnel files out of 10 personnel files did not have a completed 2912 Form.  The form was in the file, but it was not completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: In the Two Year-Old classroom a child was observed to run away from the group without a caregiver stopping her. The child ran up to the cots that were stacked up against the wall and began jumping on the top one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection, three scorpions were observed in the front office and one of the infant rooms.     A preschool classroom had large pieces of paint peeling off the wall by where a child was napping. The peeled paint was in close proximity to the childs face.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the course of this investigation, it was determined that the operation did not notify Child Care Regulation of a child that received medical treatment due to an injury while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: A parent was not immediately notified of their child's injury. There was a delay in communication from the time of the injury to the time the parent was notified and from the time the parent picked up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: The teacher was observed changing several children's diapers without washing their hands.  This was corrected when another teacher washed the hands of the children that had their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Adult scissors were found in the 18?24-year-old room in a drawer that was not child proof. All fire extinguishers located in the classrooms were observed to have an accumulation of dust. This was corrected at inspection once the scissors were removed and all fire extinguishers were cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One out of ten children's record did not have a physician's information on the enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: One out of eight infants were missing a monthly feeding schedule.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A wasp's nest with a wasp in it was seen on the playground under the roof of a playhouse.   A nail was protruding out of a playhouse accessible to children located on the infant playground.  A broken toy with sharp edges was accessible to children.  NOTE:  These 3 hazards were corrected at inspection when the assistant director called Pest control and scheduled for them to come out on today.  The assistant director was able to screw the nail in from protruding out of the playhouse roof area.  The assistant director removed the broken toy from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Seven of the 8 files reviewed during a follow up do not have health statements or their equivalents available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children in care have Epi Pens at the operation for food allergies, and no allergy emergency plans on file available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two of 10 files reviewed do not have up to date immunization information available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: 3 wasps nests were seen on the playground during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: During an inspection 1 child's Epi Pen is found to be expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: 2 garbage cans in the Early Preschool classroom bathrooms were seen uncovered with garbage accessible to children.  Note: this was corrected when lids were placed on the cans
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Eight of the 10 files reviewed do not have health statements or their equivalents available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children in care have Epi Pens at the operation for food allergies, and no allergy emergency plans on file available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder has failed to adequately respond to work order requests submitted by the operation regarding the HVAC system not working properly.  This failure to ensure that all classrooms in the building are kept at a consistent temperature has resulted in some classrooms being too cold in the winter and/or too hot in the summer for children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Recited:  Temperature measurements taken in three classrooms during the follow up inspection were lower than the city mandated lowest temperature allowed for child care facilities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Based on evidence collected during this investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to ensure that the infant classroom was warm enough for infants in care.  The classroom was observed to be very cold, with temperatures measured as low as 64.6⁰ F.  Other classrooms measured within a degree of two of this temperature, and one classroom that was not in use at the time measured at 56.5⁰ F.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was present at operation without an active background check.    NOTE: Caregiver was sent home and told must not return until results are returned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was observed grabbing a child's forearm to stop them from grabbing plastic gloves used for serving snack and yanking them  from their hand roughly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A child was observed picking up and eating a food item from the trash pile on floor that was left  by a caregiver.     A trash can in a toddler classroom was observed without a cover
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of ten children's files did not have an up-to-date immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of ten caregivers did not have verification of up-to-date CPR/FA certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A classroom for two year old children was observed with 12 children with one caregiver.  The SAG in the classroom was two years.     Note: this was corrected at inspection when a three year old child was  bumped up to a preschool classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver in the toddler classroom gave the incorrect number of children in class during naptime.  Caregiver pulled the roster on the tablet and compared with the written list and found the error.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was using harsh methods of waking children from nap by lifting the cots there were laying on with her foot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The mulch was low at exits of slides and high activity areas.  The director did not know when it was last spread/raked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Each fire extinguishers in each of the two transportation vehicles did not indicate a service date in the tag.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: A caregiver changed an infant's diaper and released them without washing their hands when done.   A caregiver did not ensure a toddler's hands were washed after changing their diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The operation was 83 degrees at the time of the inspection due to AC malfunctioning since Tuesday 6/20.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver was observed using aggressive tones with the children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver in the school age classroom was observed redirecting a child in a loud voice. The child was visibly upset during the occurrence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: There was no incident report created within the adequate timeframe and the parent was not given a written notification on the details of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an investigation: The operation is impeding an investigation by refusing to release video footage taken the day of an alleged incident that is related to an open investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an investigation (26 TAC §HRC42.04412(a) - Interference with an in)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver mistreated a child by pinching the child while in naptime causing a lesion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection was overdue as of 4/27/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of ten children's files did not have an immunization record in file.   One of ten children's files did not have a signed health care statement from their physician.   Two of ten children's files did not have the child's school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three caregivers were not current with their CPR/First aid certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of ten children's files did not have a signed medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver placed a crying child roughly outside the classroom door and closed the door to the classroom leaving child alone in another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child in the Pre K classroom did not wash their hands after having diaper changed.     Note:  this was corrected when caregiver was told to ensure child washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: While reviewing annual training records:  4 of 19 employees did not have training records available for review.  Four caregivers had not completed their required 24  hours for the 12 month period.  The director had only 18 of 30 hours completed for her annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: While reviewing children's files, 2 of 6 records reviewed did not have immunization records or statement from parent saying they refuse to immunize in the child's record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During investigation, an employee (YG) was observed working as caregiver while background check remains pending.  Director stated she has been working since Wednesday, 5/25/22.    Employee was told to go home and must  not return until background results are returned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three tenured employees of 19 employees total, did not have current CPR/First aid certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During investigation, it has been determined that yelling does occur at operation from caregivers towards children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: During investigation it was determined parents were not immediately notified of child's injury. Once an attempt was made to notify one parent, no additional attempts were made to contact second parent or anyone else when contact not achieved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection was last conducted on 3/17/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official: The last health inspection was conducted on 4/5/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official (26 TAC §746.3401(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on observation and interviews with staff the preschool and two year old classroom  were out of ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Based on interviews with staff, children and documentation proves a caregivers used inappropriate discipline by grabbing a three year old by the arm and force them to sit down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))
